no_cases_reason: No agent prompt, skill, tool description, tool result or model setting changed in 4.6.50. The only agent-code change (lumibot/components/agents/manager.py) changes how the agent detail parquet is stored: each call's rows go to a part file and the main file is rebuilt incrementally and at strategy end, instead of keeping every row in memory and rewriting the file after each call. What the model sees and what tools return are identical, so no case in agent_eval_cases could behave differently. The parquet writer now writes to a temporary file and swaps it in, with identical content. Both are covered by tests/backtest/test_agent_long_run_memory.py, tests/test_parquet_atomic_write.py and the existing agent detail parquet tests in tests/backtest/test_agent_runtime_backtest.py. The OptionsHelper delta search (used by the options_find_strike_for_delta tool) now loads candidate strikes in one batched request first; it reads the same prices and picks the same strike (tests/test_options_helper_prefetch.py, identical trades on a real one-month iron condor), so tool results are unchanged. Expired options now also settle on non-pandas backtesting sources (Alpaca, IBKR REST); the agent eval fixtures run on pandas-based sources, which already settled, so no case changes. Written by the release author on 2026-11-11.
